episode_summary: In this episode, Greg Roeder shares his journey from being an invisible agent to a top-producing luxury REALTOR by leveraging community events and targeted content. He emphasizes the importance of building genuine relationships and creating niche-specific newsletters to stay top-of-mind. Greg also discusses the significance of delegating tasks to maintain a healthy work-life balance while scaling a real estate business.
